इ: इ The third vowel of the alphabet, corresponding to I short, and pronounced as that letter in kill, &c.
इ m. (-इः) A name of KĀMADEVA. Ind. An interjection 2 Of anger. 2 Of calling. 3 Of sorrow or distress. 4 Of compassion. E. इ to go, क्विप् aff.

इ r. 1st cl. (अयति) To go, to go to or towards: with उत् prefixed, to rise or ascend, as the sun, &c. with अभि and उत् the same, or to rise in the world, to prosper. (ङ) इङ् and अधि always prefixed अधीङ r. 2nd cl. (अधीते) To study, to learn, to read over or through. (क) इक and अधि prefixed r. 2nd cl. (अध्येति) To remember, to think of. (ण) इण् r. 2nd cl. (एति) To go. This root takes many prefixes, implying with अति, 1 to surpass, to surmount. 2 To pass, to spend time or to elapse as time. With अनु, 1 To go after, to follow. 2 To go like, to imitate in going. 3 To succeed. With अभि, 1 To obtain, to get. 2 To proceed, to go on. 3 To go. 4 To approach. 5 To serve or worship. With अप 1 To go away, to depart. 2 To perish. With अभि and उप, To arrive. With उप, 1 To receive. 2 To aid or assist. 3 To approach or go near to. With निर्, to go forth or out from. With प्रति, 1 To trust, to confide. 2 To follow, to be added or subjoined to. 3 (In the passive verb,) To become evident or manifest. With वि, To expend, to waste, to depart. With सम and उप, To obtain, &c.
इक्कट: इक्कट m. (-टः) A kind of reed: see इत्कट.
इक्षु: इक्षु m. (-क्षुः) The sugar cane. E. इष to desire, and क्सु affix or ईक्ष to see, असुन् affix and ई made short.
इक्षुकाण्ड: इक्षुकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A species of sugar cane, (Saccharum munja, Rox.) see मुञ्ज. 2 A sort of grass, (Kās,) (Saccharum spontaneum.) 3 The stem or cane of the Saccharum officinale, the sugar cane. E. इक्षु and काण्ड a stem.
इक्षुगन्धा: इक्षुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 1 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 2 Barleria longifolia, (this and its synonyms are also applied to Capparis spinosa and Tribulus lanuginosus: see कोकिलाक्ष and गोक्षुरक.) 3 Convolvulus paniculatus: भूमिकुष्माण्ड. E. इक्षु and गन्ध smell; having the odor of the sugar cane.
इक्षुगन्धिका: इक्षुगन्धिका f. (-का) Convolvulus paniculatus. E. see the preceding.
इक्षुतुल्या: इक्षुतुल्या f. (-ल्या) A species of grass or reed. E. इक्षु and तुल्या like, like sugar cane.
इक्षुदण्ड: इक्षुदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The stem or cane of the Saccharum officinale, the sugar cane. E. इक्षु and दण्ड a staff.
इक्षुदर्भा: इक्षुदर्भा f. (-र्भा) A kind of grass; also वंशमूल, &c.
इक्षुनेत्र: इक्षुनेत्र (-त्रं) A kind of tree. E. इक्षु and नेत्र an eye.
इक्षुपत्र: इक्षुपत्र m. (-त्रः) A species of grain, Jowar, (Panicum spicatum). E. इक्षु and पत्र a leaf.
इक्षुप्र: इक्षुप्र m. (-प्रः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum sara.)
इक्षुबालिका: इक्षुबालिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of reed: see इक्ष्वालिका. 2 Saccharum spontaneum. E. इक्षु and बालिका an infant; a young sugar cane, from its smaller size.
इक्षुभक्षिका: इक्षुभक्षिका f. (-का) A meal of sugar or molasses. E. इक्षु, भक्ष to eat, ण्वुच् aff.
इक्षुमती: इक्षुमती f. (-ती) The name of a river in Bengal. E. इक्षु and मतुप् aff. in this sense.
इक्षुमूल: इक्षुमूल n. (-लं) 1 A sort of tree; also इक्षुनेत्र. 2 The root of sugar cane. E. इक्षु and मूल a root.
इक्षुमेह: इक्षुमेह m. (-हः) Diabetes, or D. mellitus. E. इक्षु and मेह urine.
इक्षुमेहिन्: इक्षुमेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Diabetic. E. इक्षुमेह and इनि aff.
इक्षुयन्त्र: इक्षुयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A sugar mill. E. इक्षु and यन्त्र a machine.
इक्षुयोनि: इक्षुयोनि m. (-निः) The common sugar cane. E. इक्षु and योनि origin.
इक्षुर: इक्षुर m. (-रः) 1 Sugar cane. 2 Barleria longifolia or Tribulus lanuginosus. 3 Saccharum spontaneum. E. इक्षु sugar, and र what gives, from रा and ड aff.
इक्षुरक: इक्षुरक m. (-कः) 1 Saccharum spontaneum. 2 Barleria longifolia: see the preceding, कन् being added.
इक्षुरस: इक्षुरस m. (-सः) 1 The juice of the sugar cane. 2 Molasses, unrefined sugar. 3 A sort of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. इक्षु and रस juice.
इक्षुरसक्वाथ: इक्षुरसक्वाथ m. (-थः) Raw or unrefined sugar, molasses. E. इक्षुरस and क्वाथ a decoction, the boiled or inspissated juice.
इक्षुरसोद: इक्षुरसोद m. (-दः) The sea of syrup. E. इक्षुरस and उद water.
इक्षुवाटिका: इक्षुवाटिका f. (-का) A kind of sugar cane, the common yellow cane; also इक्षुवाटी; see पुण्ड्र.
इक्षुविकार: इक्षुविकार m. (-रः) 1 Sugar, molasses. 2 Any sweetmeat. E. इक्षु and विकार change of form.
इक्षुवेष्टन: इक्षुवेष्टन m. (-नः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum munja.) E. इक्षु and वेष्टन surrounding.
इक्षुशाकट: इक्षुशाकट n. (-टं) A field of sugar cane. E. इक्षु and शाकट a field.
इक्षुशाकिन: इक्षुशाकिन n. (-नं) A field of sugar cane. E. इक्षु and शाकिन a field in this compound.
इक्षुसार: इक्षुसार m. (-रः) Molasses, raw or unrefined sugar. E. इक्षु and सार essence, the essence of the sugar cane.
इक्ष्वाकु: इक्ष्वाकु m. (-कुः) The son of the Menu VAIVASVATA, the son of SŪRYA or the sun, and first prince of the solar dynasty: he reigned at Ayodhya in the commencement of the second Yuga or age. f. (-कुः) A bitter gourd. E. इक्षु and अक to obtain, and कु or उण् aff.
इक्ष्वालिक: इक्ष्वालिक m. (-कः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) f. (-का) Another sort, (Saccharum fuscum;) the native pens are made from its stem. E. इक्षु and आलिका for आली a line; it grows like the sugar cane.
इख: इख r. 1st cl. (एखति) and (इ) इखि (इंखति) To go.
इग: इग r. 1st cl. (इ) इगि (इंगति) 1 To go, to go to or towards. 2 To move or agitate.
इङ्ग: इङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Moveable, locomotive. 2 Surprising, wonderful. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A hint or sign, an indication of sentiment by gesture, &c. 2 Knowledge. E. इगि to go, affix क.
इङ्गित: इङ्गित n. (-तं) 1 Hint, sign, gesture. 2 Going, motion. 3 Intention, purpose E. इगि to go, affix क्त.
इङ्गितज्ञ: इङ्गितज्ञ mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Understanding signs. E. इङ्गित and ज्ञ who knows.
इङ्गुद: इङ्गुद mf. (-दः-दी) The name of a plant, commonly Iṅguä. E. इङ्गु going, and द what gives; the pen. अ is changed to उ. and the fem. affix is ङीष्.
इङ्गुल: इङ्गुल mf. (-लः-ली) See the preceding. E. as before, द being changed to ल.
इच्छक: इच्छक mfn. (-कः-का-क) Wishing, desirous. m. (-कः) 1 Citron, (Citrus medica.) 2 (In arithmetic,) Demand, the sum sought. E. इच्छा wish, and वुन् aff.
इच्छत्व: इच्छत्व n. (-त्वं) Desire, wishfulness. E. इच्छा and त्व affix; also with तल, इच्छता.
इच्छन्: इच्छन् mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छंती-च्छत्) Wishing, wishful, desirous. E. इष to wish, शतृ aff.
इच्छा: इच्छा f. (-च्छा) Wish, desire. E. इष to desire, affixes श and टाप्.
इच्छानिवृत्ति: इच्छानिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Suppression of desire. E. इच्छा and निवृत्ति cessation.
इच्छान्वित: इच्छान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having desire, wishing, wishful. E. इच्छा and अन्वित possessed of.
इच्छावत्: इच्छावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wishing, wishful, desirous. f. (-ती) A woman desirous of any thing. E. इच्छा, मतुप् poss. affix, and ङीप् fem.
इच्छावसु: इच्छावसु m. (-सुः) A name of KUVERA. E. इच्छा and वसु wealth.
इच्छु: इच्छु mfn. (-च्छुः-च्छुः-च्छु) Wishing, desiring. E. इष to wish, and उस् affix, deriv. irr.
इच्छुक: इच्छुक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Wishing, desirous. E. कन् added to the last, or इच्छ and उकन् aff.
इज्जल: इज्जल m. (-लः) A small tree growing in wet and saline soil, or on low grounds near the sea, (Barringtonia acutangula.) see हिज्जल. E. इण to go, क्किप् affix, and जल water.
इज्य: इज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) A teacher. m. (-ज्यः) VṚHASPATI, the teacher or Guru of the gods. f. (-ज्या) 1 A gift, a donation. 2 Sacrificing, making offerings to the gods or manes. 3 Worship, reverence. 4 Meeting, union. 5 A cow. 6 A bawd or procuress. E. यज to sacrifice, &c. क्यप् aff.
इज्याशील: इज्याशील m. (-लः) A frequent sacrificer. E. इज्या sacrifice, and शील to be frequent, अच् aff.
इञ्चाक: इञ्चाक m. (-कः) A shrimp or prawn. E. इ love, चक to satisfy, and घञ् aff.
इट: इट r. 1st cl. (एटति) To go, to go to or towards.
इट्चर: इट्चर m. (-रः) A bull or steer allowed to go at liberty. E. इष् to wish, क्विप् affix, and चर who goes, going at will; also इड्वर.
इडा: इडा f. (-डा) 1 The wife of BUDDHA, daughter of IKṢVĀKU. 2 The earth. 3 A cow. 4 Speed. 5 A tubular vessel, one of the principal channels of the vital spirit, that which is on the right side of the body. 6 Heaven. 7 The goddess of speech. E. इल to direct or send, क affix, and टाप् fem. ल and ड are interchangeable: see इला.
इडाचिका: इडाचिका f. (-का) A wasp. E. इडा the earth, चर to go, and ड्वन् aff.
इडिका: इडिका f. (का) The earth. E. इल to direct, and वुन् affix; ल becomes ड.
इडिक्क: इडिक्क m. (-क्कः) A wild goat. E. इडिक् an imitative sound, and क who utters, from कै, affix ड.
इड्वर: इड्वर m. (-रः) A bull fit to be let at liberty. E. इष् to wish, affix क्विप्, and वृ to choose, अप् affix: see इट्चर.
इतःइतस्: इतःइतस् ind. Here here, come here. E. इतस् repeated.
इत्: इत् ind. A grammatical term, implying a letter in the inflective particles that is to be rejected.
इत: इत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Remembered. 3 Obtained. E. इण to go, affix क्त.
इतर: इतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Other, different. 2 Low, vile. E. इ desire, तृ to pass over, and अप् aff.
इतरथा: इतरथा ind. In another manner, otherwise, differently. E. था added to इतर.
इतरेतर: इतरेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Mutual, one with another. Respective, several. E. इतर repeated.
इतरेतरकाम्या: इतरेतरकाम्या f. (-म्या) Respective or several fancies or inclinations. E. इतरेतर and काम्य to be desired.
इतरेतराश्रय: इतरेतराश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Affecting or concerning mutually. E. इतरेतर and आश्रय object or receptacle.
इतरेद्युस्: इतरेद्युस् ind. Another or different day. E. इतर and एद्यस् aff.
इतस्: इतस् ind. Hence, from hence. E. irr. deriv. from इदम् this, with तसिल् aff.
इतस्ततस्: इतस्ततस् ind. Here and there, hither and thither. E. इतस् hence, ततस् thence.
इतश्चेतस्: इतश्चेतस् ind. Hither and thither. E. इतस् repeated, with च and, inserted.
इति: इति ind. A particle implying, 1 Cause, (thus, therefore.) 2 Manifestation, (lo! behold!) 3 Something additional, (et cetera.) 4 The meanings of एव, (so thus, even, in this manner) 5 Conclusion, enough, (finis.) 6 Reference, (so says, this is, &c.) It also implies, 7 Order, arrangement, specific or distinctive, and 8 Identity (of this or similar form.) 9 A grammatical copulative, indicating a preceding sound or sense, to be again intended. E. इ to go, क्तिच् aff.
इतिकथ: इतिकथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Unworthy of trust, not fit to be credited. 2 Wicked, lost. f. (-था) Unmeaning or nonsensical discourse. E. इति this, so, and कथा a saying.
इतिकर्तव्य: इतिकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is proper or necessary to be done. E. इति so, कर्त्तव्य to be done.
इतिकर्त्तव्य: इतिकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is proper or necessary to be done. E. इति so, कर्त्तव्य to be done.
इतिकर्तव्यता: इतिकर्त्तव्यता f. (-ता) Proper and right measures. E. इतिकर्त्तव्य with तल् added, or with त्व, इतिकर्त्तव्यत्वं.
इतिकर्त्तव्यता: इतिकर्त्तव्यता f. (-ता) Proper and right measures. E. इतिकर्त्तव्य with तल् added, or with त्व, इतिकर्त्तव्यत्वं.
इतिह: इतिह ind. Traditional instruction, advice, &c. mutually imparted. E. इति so, thus, and ह tidings.
इतिहास: इतिहास m. (-सः) History, traditional accounts of former events, heroic history, as the Mahābhārata and Rāmāyaṇa. E. इतिह traditional instruction, अस to be, and घञ् aff.
इत्कठ: इत्कठ mf. (-टः-टा) A kind of reed or grass; also वहूमूल. E. उत् and कठ to go, उ is changed to इ.
इत्किला: इत्किला f. (-ला) A perfume: see रोचना. E. इत obtained, and किल to play.
इत्थम्: इत्थम् ind. Thus. E. इदम् this, deriv. irr. with थमु aff.
इत्थम्भूत: इत्थम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become thus or in such manner. E. इत्यम् and भूत become.
इत्य: इत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be gone to or towards. f. (-त्या) a litter, a palankeen. E. इत् to go, क्यप् aff.
इत्यादि: इत्यादि ind. Et cetera, and so forth.
इत्वर: इत्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Low, vile. 2 Cruel, harsh. 3 A traveller. 4 Poor, indigent. 5 Going, moving, what goes. f. (-री) A disloyal or unchaste woman. E. इत and क्वरप् aff.
इद: इद r. 1st cl. (इ) इदि (इन्दति) To have supreme power and superhuman faculties.
इदम्: इदम् pron. mfn. (अयं इयं इदं) This. E. इन्द to have power, कमिन् Uṇādi affix, and the radical न rejected.
इदङ्कार्या: इदंकार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi?) E. इदम् this, and कार्य्य business; applied to this and that use.
इदंकार्य्या: इदंकार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi?) E. इदम् this, and कार्य्य business; applied to this and that use.
इदानीन्तन: इदानीन्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Present, momentary, of the present moment. E. इदानीम् and द्यु aff.
इदानीम्: इदानीम् ind. 1 Now, at present. 2 An expletive, affecting however slightly the sense. E. irr. deriv. from इदम् this, with दानीम् aff.
इदावत्सर: इदावत्सर m. (-रः) A year, one of the five sorts of years in which gifts of clothes and food are productive of great rewards.
इद्ध: इद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Lighted, alight. 2 Shining, glowing, blazing. 3 Clean, clear, bright. 4 Wonderful. 5 Obeyed, unresisted. n. (-द्ध) 1 Sunshine, light, heat. E. इन्ध to shine, affix क्त.
इध्म: इध्म n. (-ध्मं) Fuel. E. इन्धी to kindle, to burn, मक् Uṇādi aff.
इध्मप्रव्रञ्चन: इध्मप्रव्रञ्चन m. (-नं) A hatchet, an axe. E. इध्म and प्रव्रच्चन what cuts.
इन: इन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 A master, a lord. 3 A king. 4 The asterism Hasta. E. इण् to go, नक् Uṇādi aff.
इनसभ: इनसभ n. (-भं) A royal court or assembly. E. इन and सभा assembly.
इन्दम्बर: इन्दम्बर n. (-रं) The blue lotus, (Nymphaea coerulea.) E. इन्दं from इदि to possess great power, and वर what chooses, preeminent above other flowers: see इन्दीवर.
इन्दिन्दिर: इन्दिन्दिर m. (रः) A large bee. E. इदि to possess great power, deriv. irr.
इन्दिरा: इन्दिरा f. (-रा) A name of LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU. E. इदि as above, and रा who gives.
इन्दिरालय: इन्दिरालय n. (-यं) The lotus, (Nymphaea lotus.) E. इन्दिरा LAKṢMĪ, and आलय an abode; this goddess issued at the creation from the petals of the flower.
इन्दिरावर: इन्दिरावर n. (-रं) The blue lotus. E. इन्दिरा the goddess, and वर what is best; a flower beloved by LAKṢMĪ.
इन्दिवर: इन्दिवर n. (-रं) The blue lotus, (Nymphaea coerulea.) E. इन्दि for इन्दिरा q. v. the rest as in the preceding; also इन्दीवर and इन्दीवार.
इन्दीवर: इन्दीवर n. (-रं) See the preceding. f. (-री) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus). E. as before.
इन्दु: इन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. उन्द to wet or moisten; उ Uṇādi affix, and the initial changed to इ.
इन्दुकमल: इन्दुकमल n. (-लं) The white lotus. E. इन्दु the moon, and कमल the lotus.
इन्दुकला: इन्दुकला f. (-ला) A digit of the moon. E. इन्दु and कला a digit.
इन्दुकलिका: इन्दुकलिका f. (-का) The Ketakī flower. E. इन्दु and कलिका a bud.
इन्दुकान्त: इन्दुकान्त m. (-न्तः) The lunar gem, the moon-stone. E. (-न्ता) Night. E. इन्दु and कान्त a master or husband.
इन्दुजनक: इन्दुजनक m. (-कः) The ocean. E. इन्दु and जनक a parent; the moon was produced amongst other things at the churning of the ocean.
इन्दुजा: इन्दुजा f. (-जा) The Narmadā or commonly Nerbudda river in the Dekhin. E. इन्दु and जा born; the daughter of the moon.
इन्दुदल: इन्दुदल m. (-लः) A portion of the moon, a digit, a crescent, &c. E. इन्दु and दल a leaf.
इन्दुपुत्र: इन्दुपुत्र m. (-त्रः) A name of BUDHA, regent, of the planet MERCURY. E. इन्दु and पुत्र the son: the son of CANDRA or the moon.
इन्दुभृत्: इन्दुभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of ŚIVA. E. इन्दु and भृत् who nourishes; ŚIVA wears a half moon on his forehead.
इन्दुमण्डल: इन्दुमण्डल n. (-लं) The orb or disc of the moon. E. इन्दु and मण्डल sphere.
इन्दुमती: इन्दुमती f. (-ती) 1 Day of full moon. 2 Name of a princess married to AJA the son of RAGHU. E. इन्दु and मतुप् poss. affix, fem. ङीप्.
इन्दुर: इन्दुर m. (-रः) A rat. E. उन्द to moisten, उरच् affix, the initial is changed to इ.
इन्दुरत्न: इन्दुरत्न n. (-त्नं) A pearl. E. इन्दु and रत्न a gem.
इन्दुरेखा: इन्दुरेखा f. (-खा) A digit of the moon. E. इन्दु and रेखा a line.
इन्दुलेखा: इन्दुलेखा f. (-खा) 1 A digit of the moon. 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 4 A kind of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen:) see यमानिका. E. इन्दु and लेखा a line.
इन्दुलोहक: इन्दुलोहक n. (-कं) Silver. E. इन्दु and लोह iron, कन् added.
इन्दुवल्ली: इन्दुवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. इन्दु and वल्ली a creeper.
इन्दुव्रत: इन्दुव्रत n. (-तं) A religious observance depending on the age of the moon; diminishing the quantity of food by a certain portion daily, for a fortnight or a month, &c. E. इन्दु and व्रत a religious obligation.
इन्द्र: इन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 The deity presiding over Svarga or the Hindu paradise, and the secondary divinities; he is also regent of the east quarter, and is more particularly the deity of the atmosphere, corresponding in many respects with the Grecian JOVE. 2 The Supreme Being, (according to the Vedānta,) or the deity INDRA in that capacity. 3 Supremacy, supreme power or authority. 4 An Āditya, one of the twelve demigods so called. 5 One of the Yogas, or divisions of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic. 6 The human or animal soul, the portion of spirit residing in the body. 7 Night. 8 A plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica, &c.) see कुटज. 9 An organ of sense. 10 (In composition) Best, excellent. 11 The 14th lunation of the month Jyeṣṭha. 12 One of the nine divisions of Jambu Dvīpa, or the known continent. f. (-न्द्रा) 1 The name of a plant, (Marjoram?) see फणिम्भक. 2 The wife of INDRA. E. इदि to possess supreme power, and रन् Uṇādi aff.
इन्द्रक: इन्द्रक n. (-कं) An assembly-room, a hall. E. इन्द्र excellent, and क what sounds, from कै and ड aff.
इन्द्रकील: इन्द्रकील m. (-लः) The mountain Mandara, a fabulous mountain with which the ocean was churned. E. इन्द्र and कील a pin or bolt.
इन्द्रकुञ्जर: इन्द्रकुञ्जर m. (-रः) INDRA'S elephant. E. इन्द्र and कुञ्जर an elephant.
इन्द्रकोष: इन्द्रकोष m. (-षः) 1 A platform, a scaffold. 2 A projection of the roof of a house, forming a kind of balcony or terrace. 3 A pin or bracket projecting from the wall. E. इन्द्र best, and कोष a place.
इन्द्रगोप: इन्द्रगोप m. (-ग्रः) An insect, (Coccinella of various kinds.) E. इन्द्र best, गो light, and प from पा who nourishes or possesses.
इन्द्रच्छन्दस्: इन्द्रछन्दस् n. (-न्दः) A necklace of a thousand strings. E. इन्द्र best, and छन्दस् a necklace, &c.
इन्द्रछन्दस्: इन्द्रछन्दस् n. (-न्दः) A necklace of a thousand strings. E. इन्द्र best, and छन्दस् a necklace, &c.
इन्द्रजाल: इन्द्रजाल n. (-लं) 1 Conjuring, juggling. 2 Deception, cheating. 3 Trick or stratagem in war. E. इन्द्र an organ of sense, and जाल a net.
इन्द्रजालिक: इन्द्रजालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 A juggler, a conjuror. 2 Deceptive, unreal. E. इन्द्रजाल illusion, and ठक् aff.
इन्द्रजित्: इन्द्रजित् m. (-जित्) The son of RĀVAṆA. E. इन्द्र and जित् who conquers: the conqueror of INDRA.
इन्द्रजिद्विजयिन्: इन्द्रजिद्विजयिन् m. (-यी) LAKṢMAṆA, the brother of RĀMA. E. इन्द्रजित् and विजयिन् a victor, the conqueror of INDRAJIT.
इन्द्रतूल: इन्द्रतूल n. (-लं) A flock of cotton, a flocculent seed, &c. blown about in the air. E. इन्द्र and तूल cotton: INDRA'S cotton.
इन्द्रतूलक: इन्द्रतूलक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. as before, कण् added.
इन्द्रदारु: इन्द्रदारु m. (-रुः) A tree, (Pinus devadaru.) E. इन्द्र and दारु tree.
इन्द्रद्रु: इन्द्रद्रु n. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna, Rox.) E. इन्द्र and द्रु a tree; a staff of which is fit to carry the banner of INDRA.
इन्द्रद्रुम: इन्द्रद्रुम m. (-मः) See the preceding. E. as before.
इन्द्रनील: इन्द्रनील m. (-लः) A sapphire. E. इन्द्र best, and नील blue.
इन्द्रनीलक: इन्द्रनीलक m. (-कः) An emerald. E. see the preceding.
इन्द्रपुष्पा: इन्द्रपुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A medicinal plant; also अग्निजिह्वा. E. इन्द्र and पुष्पा a flower: also इन्द्रपुष्पिका.
इन्द्रपुरोहिता: इन्द्रपुरोहिता f. (-ता) The asterism Puṣya. E. इन्द्र and पुरोहिता priest, INDRA presiding over it.
इन्द्रप्रस्थ: इन्द्रप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) Ancient Dehli. E. इन्द्र the deity, and प्रस्थ who presides.
इन्द्रप्रहरण: इन्द्रप्रहरण n. (-णं) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. इन्द्र and प्रहरण a weapon.
इन्द्रभेषज: इन्द्रभेषज n. (-जं) Dried ginger. E. इन्द्र best, and भेषज medicament.
इन्द्रमहकामुक: इन्द्रमहकामुक m. (-कः) A dog. E. इन्द्र, मह a sacrifice, and कामुक desirous.
इन्द्रमूल: इन्द्रमूल n. (-लं) A flock of cotton: see इन्द्रतूल.
इन्द्रयव: इन्द्रयव mn. (-वः-वं) The seed of the Wrightea antidysenterica. E. इन्द्र the plant, and यव seed: it is used medicinally in cases of diarrhoea, dysentery, &c.
इन्द्रलुप्त: इन्द्रलुप्त mn. (-प्तः-प्तं) Morbid baldness, falling of the hair of the head: according to some authorities, loss of beard. E. इन्द्र best, लुप्त lost.
इन्द्रलुप्तक: इन्द्रलुप्तक m. (-कः) See the preceding. E. as before, वुन् aff.
इन्द्रलोक: इन्द्रलोक m. (-कः) Svarga or paradise, the heaven of INDRA. E. इन्द्र and लोक world.
इन्द्रलोकेश: इन्द्रलोकेश m. (-शः) 1 INDRA. 2 A guest, hospitality to whom secures paradise. E. इन्द्रलोक and ईश lord.
इन्द्रवारुणिका: इन्द्रवारुणिका f. (-का) Colocynth, a wild bitter gourd, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. कन् added to इन्द्रवारुणी.
इन्द्रवारुणी: इन्द्रवारुणी f. (-णी) See the preceding. E. इन्द्र and वरुण the two deities so called, affixes अण् and ङीप्; the favourite plant of INDRA and VARUṆA.
इन्द्रवृक्ष: इन्द्रवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A kind of fir: see देवदारु. E. इन्द्र for any god, वृक्ष a tree.
इन्द्रव्रत: इन्द्रव्रत n. (-तं) One of the duties of a king, to distribute gratification, as INDRA pours down rain. E. इन्द्र and व्रत observance.
इन्द्रवृद्धा: इन्द्रवृद्धा f. (-द्धा) A sore, an ulcer.
इन्द्रशक्ति: इन्द्रशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) INDRĀṆĪ, the wife or personified energy of INDRA. E. इन्द्र and शक्ति power.
इन्द्रसावर्णि: इन्द्रसावर्णि m. (-र्णिः) The last of the fourteen Menus. E. इन्द्र and सावर्णि the son of the sun.
इन्द्रसुत: इन्द्रसुत m. (-तः) The monkey king BĀLĪ. E. इन्द्र and सुत a son; the son of INDRA: the epithet is also applied to ARJUNA and JAYANTA.
इन्द्रसुरस: इन्द्रसुरस m. (-सः) A shrub, the leaves of which are used in discutient applications, (Vitex negundo;) also सिन्दुवार. E. इन्द्र best, सु good, and रस juice; whose juice is excellent.
इन्द्रसुरिस: इन्द्रसुरिस m. (-सः) See the preceding. E. as before, the pen. being changed to इ.
इन्द्रसूनु: इन्द्रसूनु m. (-नुः) The son of INDRA: see इन्द्रसुत.
इन्द्राणिका: इन्द्राणिका f. (-का) Vitex negundo: see इन्द्रसुरस. E. कन् added to the next word.
इन्द्राणी: इन्द्राणी f. (-णी) 1 The wife of INDRA. 2 A plant, (Vitex negundo:) see the preceding. E. इन्द्र, ङीष् affix, and आनुक augment.
इन्द्रानुज: इन्द्रानुज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. इन्द्र and अनुज younger born: the younger brother of INDRA.
इन्द्रायुध: इन्द्रायुध m. (-धः) The rainbow. f. (-धा) A kind of leech of various tints on the back. E. इन्द्र and आयुध a weapon; INDRA'S weapon.
इन्द्रारि: इन्द्रारि m. (-रिः) An Asura or demon. E. इन्द्र and अरि an enemy.
इन्द्रावरज: इन्द्रावरज m. (-जः) VIṢṆU. E. इन्द्र and अवरज after-born: the younger brother of INDRA.
इन्द्राशन: इन्द्राशन m. (-नः) 1 Hemp, dried and chewed. 2 The shrub which bears the seed used as jeweller's weight, (Abrus precatorius). E. इन्द्र and अशन food: the food of INDRA.
इन्द्रासन: इन्द्रासन n. (-नं) 1 The throne of INDRA. 2 Any throne. E. इन्द्र and असन a seat.
इन्द्रिय: इन्द्रिय n. (-यं) 1 An organ of sense divided into three classes, Jñānendriyas, Karmendriyas, and Antarindriyas, or organs of perception and action, and the internal organs; the first are the eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin; the second, the organ of speech or larynx, hand, foot, anus, and parts of generation; the last are, Manas the mind or organ of thought; Buddhi the organ of apprehension; Ahaṅkāra the organ of selfishness; and Citta the heart or organ of feeling. 2 Semen virile. mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Done, seen, given, &c. by INDRA. E. इन्द्र the soul or self, and इयच् affix, deriv. irr. what is with difficulty restrained by the soul, or इन्द्र the deity, and घ aff.
इन्द्रियगोचर: इन्द्रियगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Perceptible, capable of being ascertained by the senses. E. इन्द्रिय and गोचर perceptible.
इन्द्रियग्राम: इन्द्रियग्राम m. (-मः) The senses or organs of sense collectively. E. इन्द्रिय and ग्राम here, assemblage.
इन्द्रियज्ञान: इन्द्रियज्ञान n. (-नं) The faculty of perception, sense, consciousness. E. इन्द्रिय and ज्ञान knowledge.
इन्द्रियनिग्रह: इन्द्रियनिग्रह m. (-हः) Restraining the organs of sense. E. इन्द्रिय and निग्रह restraint.
इन्द्रियबुद्धि: इन्द्रियबुद्धि f. (द्धिः) Perception, the exercise of any sense, the faculty of any organ. E. इन्द्रिय and बुद्धि knowledge.
इन्द्रियबोधन: इन्द्रियबोधन n. (-नं) Any excitement of sense, an object of perception, a stimulus, &c. E. इन्द्रिय and बोधन waking.
इन्द्रियवर्ग: इन्द्रियवर्ग m. (-र्गः) The organs of sense collectively. E. इन्द्रिय and वर्ग a class.
इन्द्रियविप्रतिपत्ति: इन्द्रियविप्रतिपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Erroneous or vicious perception. E. इन्द्रिय and विप्रतिपत्ति perversion.
इन्द्रियस्वाप: इन्द्रियस्वाप m. (-पः) 1 Unconsciousness, insensibility. 2 The end of the world. E. इन्द्रिय and स्वाप sleep.
इन्द्रियागोचर: इन्द्रियागोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Imperceptible. E. इन्द्रिय and अगोचर imperceptible.
इन्द्रियायतन: इन्द्रियायतन n. (-नं) The body. E. इन्द्रिय and आयतन a mansion: the residence of the senses.
इन्द्रियार्थ: इन्द्रियार्थ m. (-र्थः) An object of sense, as sound, smell, &c. E. इन्द्रिय and अर्थ an object.
इन्द्रियासङ्ग: इन्द्रियासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Stoicism, philosophy, detachment from sensual objects. E. इन्द्रिय and असङ्ग detachment.
इन्द्रेज्य: इन्द्रेज्य m. (-ज्यः) The name of VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods. E. इन्द्र and इज्य to be worshipped; venerable to the deities.
इन्ध: इन्ध r. 7th cl. (ई and ञि) ञिइन्धी (इन्धे) 1 To shine. 2 To kindle.
इन्धन: इन्धन n. (-नं) Fuel; wood, grass, &c. used for that purpose. E. इन्ध to kindle, and ल्युट् aff.
इन्वका: इन्वका f. plu. (-काः) Stars in the head of Orion. E. इवि to please, क्वुन् affix: see इल्वला and इल्वका.
इभ: इभ r. 10th cl. (इ) इभि (इम्भयते) To collect or accumulate.
इभ m. (-भः) 1 An elephant. 2 Best (in composition.) E. इण to go, भन् Uṇādi aff.
इभकणा: इभकणा f. (-णा) A plant with an aromatic seed, (Pothos officinalis.) E. इभ an elephant, and कणा pepper; being considered by Hindu writers, as a large species of pepper: see गजपिप्पली.
इभदन्ता: इभदन्ता f. (-न्ता) A plant: see नागदन्ती. E. इभ and दन्त a tooth: this and similar names are given, from its supposed resemblance to an elephant's tooth.
इभनिमीलिका: इभनिमीलिका f. (-का) Smartness, shrewdness, wittiness. E. इभ and निभनिमीलिका winking; winking knowingly like an elephant.
इभपालक: इभपालक m. (-कः) The driver or keeper of an elephant. E. इभ, पालक a nourisher.
इभपोटा: इभपोटा f. (-टा) A young elephant, a cub. E. इभ and पोटा any young animal.
इभमाचल: इभमाचल m. (-लः) A lion. E. इभ an elephant, in the second case, आ and चल who attacks.
इभयुवति: इभयुवति f. (-तिः) An elephant's cub. E. इभ and युवति young.
इभाख्य: इभाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea:) see नागकेशर. E. इभ and आख्या an appellation; named from the elephant.
इभोषणा: इभोषणा f. (-णा) A kind of aromatic plant: see इभकणा. E. इभ and उषणा pepper.
इभ्य: इभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Wealthy, opulent. f. (-भ्या) 1 A female elephant. 2 The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. इभ an elephant; here also implying excellence, and यत् affix of appropriation or fitness.
इयत्: इयत् mfn. (-यान्-यती-यत्) So much, thus much. E. इदम् this, and वतुप् aff.
इयत्ता: इयत्ता f. (-त्ता) Fixed measure or quantity, so much. E. इयत् and तल् affix; also with त्व, इयत्त्व.
इरण: इरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Desert. 2 Salt or barren, (soil:) E. see इराण.
इरम्मद: इरम्मद m. (-दः) 1 A flash of lightning, or the fire attending the fall of a thunderbolt. 2 Submarine fire. E. इरा water, here also watery clouds, and मद what plays or shines.
इरा: इरा f. (-रा) 1 The earth. 2 Water. 3 Speech. 4 The goddess of speech, &c. 5 Ardent spirits. E. इण to go, and रन् Uṇādi affix, fem. affix टाप्.
इराचर: इराचर m. (-रः) Hail. mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Earth-born, terrestrial. 2 Aquatic. E. इरा water, &c. and चर what goes.
इराज: इराज m. (-जः) A name of KANDARPA, the Hindu CUPID. E. इरा water, and ज born.
इरावत्: इरावत् m. (-वान्) 1 The ocean. 2 A cloud. 3 A king. mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Watery, having or yielding water, &c. E. इरा and मतुप् aff.
इरावेल्लिका: इरावेल्लिका f. (-का) Pimples or pustules on the head.
इरिण: इरिण n. (-णं) 1 A desert, an inhospitable region. 2 Salt or barren soil. E. ऋ to go, इनन् Uṇādi affix, and the initial changed to इ.
इरिमेद: इरिमेद m. (-दः) A fetid mimosa: see विट्खदिर. E. see अरिमेद, अ being changed to इ.
इरेश: इरेश m. (-शः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A king, a sovereign. 3 VARUṆA. E. इरा SARASVATĪ, &c. and ईश lord.
इर्वारु: इर्व्वारु mf. (-रुः-रुः) 1 A cucumber, (Cumumis utilatissimus, Rox.) 2 Another kind, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. इरु a seed, and आरु what goes to or gets, from ऋ and उण् affix, or आलु, र becoming ल; also written इर्व्वालु, ईर्व्वारु, उर्व्वारु, &c.
इर्व्वारु: इर्व्वारु mf. (-रुः-रुः) 1 A cucumber, (Cumumis utilatissimus, Rox.) 2 Another kind, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. इरु a seed, and आरु what goes to or gets, from ऋ and उण् affix, or आलु, र becoming ल; also written इर्व्वालु, ईर्व्वारु, उर्व्वारु, &c.
इर्वारुशुक्तिका: इर्व्वारुशुक्तिका f. (-का) A kind of melon; commonly Sphuti or Sphut, (Cucumis momordica.) E. इर्व्वारु and शुक्तिका an oyster-shaped cucumber.
इर्व्वारुशुक्तिका: इर्व्वारुशुक्तिका f. (-का) A kind of melon; commonly Sphuti or Sphut, (Cucumis momordica.) E. इर्व्वारु and शुक्तिका an oyster-shaped cucumber.
इल: इल r. 6th cl. (इलति) 1 To sleep. 2 To go. 3 To throw, send or direct: in this last sense, it is also r. 10th cl. (एलयति.)
इलविला: इलविला f. (-ला) The mother of KUVERA.
इला: इला f. (-ला) 1 The wife of BUDDHA, and daughter of IKṢVĀKU. 2 The earth. 3 A cow. 4 Speech. E. इल to send, क and टाप् affixes; also इडा.
इलागोल: इलागोल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe. E. इला and गोल a sphere.
इलातल: इलातल n. (-लं) 1 The fourth place in the circle of the zodiac. 2 The surface of the earth. E. इला and तल below.
इलावृत: इलावृत n. (-तं) One of the nine Varṣas or divisions of the known world, comprehending the highest and most centrical part of the old continent. E. इला the earth, and आवृत chosen: the fairest part of the globe.
इलिका: इलिका f. (-का) The earth. E. इल to go, कन् and टाप् affixes.
इली: इली f. (-ली) A cudgel, a stick shaped like a sword or a short sword: see ईली.
इलीश: इलीश m. (-शः) A fish, commonly the Hilsa or Sable, (Clupea alosa.) E. इल to go, (in the water,) and ईश chief, principal. The fish being one of high flavour, and very abundant at certain seasons, it is generally eaten both by the natives of Bengal, and by Europeans residing there.
इल्लल: इल्लल m. (-लः) A bird. E. इल to go, and अल who is able.
इल्लिश: इल्लिश m. (-शः) The Hilsa fish: see इलीश; also ईल्लीश.
इल्वका: इल्वका f. plu. (-काः) Stars in Orion's head: see इल्वल.
इल्वल: इल्वल m. (-लः) 1 The name of a demon. 2 Of a fish. f. plu. (-लाः) Stars in Orion's head. E. इल to send or go, and वल Uṇādi affix; the last is also written इल्वका ut sup.
इव: इव r. 1st cl. (इ) इवि (इंवति) 1 To pervade. 2 (According to some,) to please. 3 To be satisfied.
इव ind. So, even, as, like, in the same manner.
इशीका: इशीका f. (-का) An elephant's eye-ball: see इषीका.
इष: इष r. 4th cl. (इष्यति) To go. r. 6th cl. (इच्छति) 1 To wish, to desire. 2 To accept, to receive. With अभि, to desire: with प्रति, to engage, to promise. r. 9th cl. (इष्णाति) To repeat an act, to do any thing again and again. With अनु prefixed, to search after, to investigate or enquire.
इष m. (-षः) The month Āśvina, (September-October.) E. इष to go, क affix; also ईष.
इषिका: इषिका f. (-का) 1 An elephant's eye-ball. 2 A painter's brush, &c. also इषीका.
इषिर: इषिर m. (रः) Fire. E. इष to go, किरच् aff.
इषीका: इषीका f. (-का) 1 An elephant's eye-ball. 2 A painter's brush, &c. also इषिका. 3 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. इष to go, ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
इषु: इषु mf. (-षुः) 1 An arrow. 2 A versed sine. E. इष to go, and उ Uṇādi aff.
इषुधर: इषुधर m. (-रः) An archer. E. इषु and धर who bears.
इषुधि: इषुधि mf. (-धिः) A quiver. E. इषु and धि what holds, from धा root, and कि aff.
इष्ट: इष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Wished, desired. 2 Cherished, beloved. 3 Worshipped, reverenced, respected. m. (-ष्टः) 1 A lover, a husband. 2 The Castor-oil tree. n. (-ष्टं) 1 An act of sacrifice, an oblation, &c. 2 An essential ceremony, as ablution, investiture, &c. Ind. (-ष्टम) Voluntarily. E. इष to desire, or इष substituted for यज to sacrifice, and क्त aff.
इष्टकर्मन्: इष्टकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) (In arithmetic,) Rule of supposition, operation with an assumed number. E. इष्ट wished, and कर्म्मन् act.
इष्टकर्म्मन्: इष्टकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) (In arithmetic,) Rule of supposition, operation with an assumed number. E. इष्ट wished, and कर्म्मन् act.
इष्टका: इष्टका f. (-का) A brick; also इष्टिका. E. इष to wish, तकक् Uṇādi aff.
इष्टकान्यास: इष्टकान्यास m. (-सः) Laying the foundation of a house. E. इष्टका and न्यास order.
इष्टकापथ: इष्टकापथ n. (-थं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum). E. इष्ट wished, and कापथ a bad road, growing in or preferring unfrequented places: this word is sometimes divided, कापथ being one name, and इष्ट added to अवदाह, another name: see अवदाहेष्ट and अवदाह.
इष्टकाराशि: इष्टकाराशि f. (-शिः) A pile of bricks. E. इष्टका and राशि a heap.
इष्टगन्ध: इष्टगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Fragrant, any fragrant substance. n. (-न्धं) Sand. E. इष्ट and गन्ध a smell; of a desirable odor.
इष्टतम: इष्टतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Beloved, best beloved, dearest, most desired. E. इष्ट and तमप् aff.
इष्टतर: इष्टतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dearer, more dear, more desired. E. इष्ट and तरप् aff.
इष्टत्व: इष्टत्व n. (त्वं) 1 Desirableness. 2 Reverence, &c. also इष्टता. E. तल् or त्व added to इष्ट.
इष्टदेव: इष्टदेव m. (-वः) A tutelary deity, one particularly worshipped. E. इष्ट and देव a deity.
इष्टदेवता: इष्टदेवता f. (-ता) A person's chosen or tutelary divinity. E. इष्ट and देवता divinity.
इष्टापूर्त: इष्टापूर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) Any religious duty, a oblation, sacrifice, penance, holy study, digging a well, planting a tree, &c. E. इष्ट a sacrifice, and पूर्त्त liberal act, religiously considered; आङ् prefixed to the latter.
इष्टापूर्त्त: इष्टापूर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) Any religious duty, a oblation, sacrifice, penance, holy study, digging a well, planting a tree, &c. E. इष्ट a sacrifice, and पूर्त्त liberal act, religiously considered; आङ् prefixed to the latter.
इष्टार्थोद्युक्त: इष्टार्थोद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Zealously active, diligent for a desired object. E. इष्ट wished, अर्थ intention, and उद्युक्त diligent.
इष्टि: इष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Wish, desire. 2 A sacrifice, any sacrificial rite. 3 A compendious verse easily committed to memory. E. इष to wish, or इष substituted for यज, to sacrifice; affix क्तिन्.
इष्टिका: इष्टिका f. (-का) A brick. E. more usually इष्टका.
इष्टिन्: इष्टिन् mfn. (-ष्टी-ष्टिनी-ष्टि) Who wishes or desires, desirous, wishing. E. इष्ट and इनि aff.
इष्टिपच: इष्टिपच m. (-चः) A demon. E. इष्टि a sacrifice or oblation, and पच who digests: stealing oblations to the deities, and eating them.
इष्टिमुष्: इष्टिमुष् m. (-मुट्) A demon. E. इष्टि an oblation, and मुष् who steals; from मुष root, and क्विप् aff.
इष्टु: इष्टु f. (-ष्टुः) Desire, wish. E. इष to wish, तु aff.
इष्ट्वा: इष्ट्वा ind. 1 Having sacrificed or worshipped. 2 Having wished. E. इष with क्त्वा aff.
इष्म: इष्म m. (-ष्मः) 1 Love or the deity KĀMA. 2 Spring. E. इष to desire, and मक् Uṇādi aff.
इष्य: इष्य m. (-ष्यः) The spring season. E. इष to wish, and क्यप् aff.
इष्व: इष्व m. (-ष्वः) A spiritual preceptor. E. इष to wish, वन् Uṇādi aff.
इष्वास: इष्वास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) A thrower of arrows. m. (-सः) 1 A bow. 2 An archer, a warrior. E. इषु an arrow, and आस who throws.
इस्: इस् ind. (-इः) An interjection of anger, pain, or sorrow.
इह: इह ind. 1 Here, in this place. 2 Now, at this time.
इहकाल: इहकाल m. (-लः) This life. E. इह and काल time.
इहलोक: इहलोक m. (-कः) This life, this world. E. इह and लोक world.
इहामूत्र: इहामूत्र ind. Here and there, in this world and in the next. E. इह here, अमूत्र there or in that. ई
